description: Australia-wide dot-density map of occupied homes by housing type, 2021 Census. Each dot represents about 2,000 homes within a statistical region. Includes all states, the Australian Capital Territory, the Northern Territory and Jervis Bay. Excludes three offshore territories. Housing context for pet ownership; dots do not count pets.

signals.name: placementSeed
signals.description: Fixed seed keeps illustrative positions identical across redraws and returning to a species.

signals.name: colorSurface
signals.description: Colour: white, the colour of the card each chart sits on. This is only a backup; the real colour comes from --color-surface in css/style.css.

signals.name: fontBody
signals.description: Font: the plain font for all other text (Fira Sans). This is only a backup; the real font comes from --font-body in css/style.css.

signals.name: width
signals.description: Measured by the loader; small-screen charts keep a compact minimum width.

signals.name: narrow
signals.description: Compact chart breakpoint; all source observations remain available.

signals.name: housingType
signals.description: Choose one dwelling count; all options retain the same homes-per-dot scale.

signals.name: homesPerDot
signals.description: A dot represents about 2,000 occupied private dwellings; round separately for each region.

signals.name: plotHeight
signals.description: Fit the whole mainland and Tasmania within the available card width.

signals.name: focusCode
signals.description: A pinned region takes precedence over hover. Changing the home type clears focus in the same update as the regenerated dots.

transform.expr: housingType === 'Detached houses' ? datum.properties.houses : housingType === 'Apartments or flats' ? datum.properties.apartments : datum.properties.total

tooltip.signal: {'Region': datum.name, 'Home type': housingType, 'Occupied homes': format(datum.count, ',.0f'), 'Census year': 2021, 'Each dot represents': 'About 2,000 homes', 'Dot locations': 'Placed at random inside each region, not at real addresses'}

usermeta.method: Counts from the Australian Bureau of Statistics 2021 Census table G37, occupied private dwellings excluding visitor-only and other non-classifiable households. Each region is rounded independently to 2,000-home dots. Fixed-seed area-uniform placement uses simplified boundaries and excludes holes. Dots do not locate actual homes or estimate pet ownership. Privacy adjustments mean regional sums can differ slightly from published national totals.
usermeta.coverage: 337 geographic regions across all states and mainland territories, plus Jervis Bay. Christmas Island, Cocos (Keeling) Islands and Norfolk Island omitted from this mainland-and-Tasmania view. Non-geographic records excluded.
